description:
Timescope | traverse time

Experience the city through open-air walking tours designed for small groups. We transform urban landscapes into living narratives. Our journeys, like the Origins of paris and the Symbol of paris, reveal the hidden layers of monuments where you stand.

Ready to walk through time?

►  explore our experiences: www.timescope.co
► follow the journey on instagram: @timescope
